about: Terms of use per necklace member, one place for every definition and template stamp (PM 13:53, 11-15). Key: an external member's resource_id, or agent:<agent_id> for our own agents outside the fallback catalogue. status allowed | silent | prohibits; source (https) and checked_at are required, basis names the clause. Written by the agent team (reports/necklace-terms-2026-11-15); a member missing here is unknown. Every change appends to changes (member, from, to, source, at, by): use `python -m scripts.necklace_gate set-terms`.
